# SkillGuard
> SkillGuard is an open-source CLI that scans, scores, and pins Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex before install.

## Core commands
- scan: identify risky patterns (prompt injection, remote exec, obfuscation, secrets) and summarize severity
- lock: write per-skill skill-lock.json with a content hash
- install: gated copy to target agent skills folder (requires passing scan + matching lock)

## Install from source
- Requirements: Node.js >= 22.12
- Steps:
  - git clone https://github.com/jaymsoni/SkillGuard.git
  - cd SkillGuard
  - npm ci
  - npm run build
  - npm link  # optional: adds `skillguard` to PATH; or run: node dist/cli.cjs

## Target skill folders
- Cursor: ~/.cursor/skills/
- Generic agents: ~/.agents/skills/
- Claude: personal ~/.claude/skills/, project ./.claude/skills/
